dedupe_keys.name: pescara road crash records and statistics 2012 and 20152017

description: The Province of Pescara publishes vehicle-incident reports labelled 2012 and 2015–2017. Both native field schemas name report/document identifiers, incident date, municipality, address, case status and vehicle references. The two period-labelled reports belong to the same provincial source series and are retained together. They do not establish a continuous sequence across the intervening years. The schema does not establish road geometry, crash severity, injured-person totals or actual vehicle attributes. Reports may overlap, and their number is not inferred. No case values or personal details were read. Coverage is Pescara, Italy. The source declares the CC BY 4.0 licence and CSV access links. Metadata are public; later file-use costs and completeness remain unknown. No specific simulation application is documented. Related tables are grouped by the named publisher, police/incident subject and stated period; unrelated municipal datasets are not included.
